title: Multi and Air Jump
description: Multi-Jump is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds a configurable double jump / multi-air-jump system to your server.
body:
**Multi Air Jump** is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds a configurable double jump / multi-air-jump system to your server.

Players can jump multiple times in mid-air and get launched in the direction they are looking.
The amount of air jumps, jump strength, worlds, gamemodes and effects are fully configurable.
The plugin is exploit-safe, performance-friendly and does not allow real flying.
Perfect for hub servers, parkour maps, minigames and fun movement-based gameplay.

**Commands:**

**/jump reloadconfig**
Reloads the config.yml without restarting the server.

**Permissions:**

**jump.use**

Allows players to use air jumps (only required if enabled in the config).

**jump.reload**

Allows reloading the config with /jump reloadconfig (default: OP).
